visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Early Integer Division
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The third row of Pascal's triangle should be 1 2 1, but the program prints 1 2 0.

solution.explanation: Dividing (n - k) by (k + 1) first throws away the remainder: 1 / 2 is 0 in integer arithmetic. Multiplying first keeps the product exact, and the division that follows is always exact.
